practice_areas.name: Personal Injury
practice_areas.description: Injury claims arising from vehicle collisions, premises incidents, and workplace accidents, typically against an insured party.

practice_areas.name: Employment Law
practice_areas.description: Wrongful termination, discrimination, wage-and-hour, and severance disputes on behalf of employees.

practice_areas.name: Family Law
practice_areas.description: Divorce, custody, support, and related domestic-relations matters.

practice_areas.name: Estate Planning & Probate
practice_areas.description: Wills, trusts, powers of attorney, and probate administration.

practice_areas.name: Business & Commercial
practice_areas.description: Contract disputes, entity formation, and commercial transactions for small and mid-size businesses.

practice_areas.name: Criminal Defense
practice_areas.description: Defense of misdemeanor and felony charges, from investigation through trial.
